summary: Ashland Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement providing a $500 million five-year unsecured revolving credit facility. The facility is used for working capital and general corporate purposes, with borrowings available to Ashland and its Swiss subsidiary. This is a routine refinancing of existing credit arrangements, not a special situation event like an acquisition or restructuring. No deal terms, premium, or shareholder action are involved; it is standard debt management for ongoing operations.
